snippets.output: Muscle strain, also known as pulled muscle, typically causes pain that can resolve within a few days to several weeks, depending on the severity of the strain.
Mild muscle strains usually improve within a few days to a week.
Moderate muscle strains may last for several weeks, often 2 to 3 weeks.
Severe muscle strains can cause pain and dysfunction lasting several months and may require rehabilitation.
The healing time for muscle strains can vary based on the individual's overall health, the specific muscle involved, and adherence to recommended treatment protocols.
Rest, ice, compression, elevation, and over-the-counter pain medications are commonly used to manage muscle strain symptoms.
